123:t_1:3.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　Briefing Room～

123:t_1:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Taking $$セントラル・ベース$$ will be hugely important to our future battles against the $$新地球皇国$$.」

123:t_1:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Victory here will be a major turning point in North America, where the Empire and the $$地球連邦$$ are evenly matched.」

123:t_1:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「At the same time, this battle is an ideal chance to obtain information about $$サイデリアル$$.」

123:t_1:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've fought the Empire in various ways these past two months, but we know far too little about the enemy.」

123:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even the idea that they're building a system to draw out Earth's $$次元力|lc$$ through $$レイライン$$s is only speculation.」

123:t_1:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To learn the Empire's goals, scale, and strategy, we must succeed in taking $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

123:t_1:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Is there any guarantee that taking that base will get us all that information?」

123:t_1:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At least we know for certain that $$セントラル・ベース$$ is the Empire's largest stronghold in North America.」

123:t_1:14.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The Empire covers Earth with $$レイライン$$s and bases, centered on its capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

123:t_1:15.en:
$n
「I've heard it's like a spiderweb spread over the whole Earth.」

123:t_1:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's right. From another perspective, we could say the Empire controls Earth through points and lines.」

123:t_1:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$ is especially important among those points. We can assume it links directly to $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

123:t_1:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I intend to infiltrate that network and obtain as much information as possible.」

123:t_1:19.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Then you'll have to hack it before the battle for the base is decided.」

123:t_1:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If the Empire realizes it's losing, its forces might destroy the base facilities themselves.」

123:t_1:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that means you'll have to infiltrate the base during the battle.」

123:t_1:23.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If that's the only way, I'll do it.」

123:t_1:24.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll go with you, $$ティエリア$$.」

123:t_1:25.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Having you along would be reassuring.」

123:t_1:26.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ティエリア$$. This is for our future battles with the Empire, too.」

123:t_1:27.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I also intend to investigate as much as I can about 《$$ヴェーダ$$》, which they stole from us.」

123:t_1:28.en:
$$オットー$$
「The regular forces will launch a diversion nearby. For their sake, too, we must make this operation succeed.」

123:t_1:32.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We just received word from the $$地球連邦軍$$. $$トウキョウ$$ in 《$$新日本$$》 has fallen.」

123:t_1:34.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Wait...! Isn't $$ゼロ$$ in $$新日本$$?!」

123:t_1:35.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I heard he and General $$藤堂$$ were commanding the fight against the Empire...」

123:t_1:37.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The Federation forces don't know the details yet, but with the capital, $$トウキョウ$$, fallen, $$新日本$$'s chain of command has collapsed completely.」

123:t_1:39.en:
$$オットー$$
「Damn the Empire... So they're finally launching an offensive against the Pacific Rim as well.」

123:t_1:40.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then taking $$セントラル・ベース$$ is all the more important.」

123:t_1:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Liberating North America will strike a blow against the Empire and hold its strategy in check...」

123:t_1:43.en:
$$レイアム$$
「In 24 hours, we will attempt to break through the defense line. Everyone, finish servicing your machines and stand by until then.」

123:t_1:45.en:
$n
「Let's focus on what we can do, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

123:t_1:47.en:
$n
「I understand. Now that $$新日本$$ has fallen, Japan will eventually come under attack by the Empire too...」

123:t_1:48.en:
$n
「That's exactly why we have to make the operation to take $$セントラル・ベース$$ succeed.」

123:t_1:50.en:
$$エマ$$
「The guardian roles have completely reversed.」

123:t_1:52.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Hee hee... Now that $n has grown stronger, you don't have to worry about the age gap either, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

123:t_1:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「H-Hey...! What are you saying, $$フォウ$$?!」

123:t_1:54.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Lieutenant $$エマ$$ said it too. A man really ought to take the lead to some extent.」

123:t_1:56.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Sorry for bringing up something unnecessary before the operation.」

123:t_1:57.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But we're about to face a big battle. I think being honest with yourself is important, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

123:t_1:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't seem too unhappy about it.」

123:t_1:61.en:
$$ファ$$
「Are you okay with being treated like that?」

123:t_1:62.en:
$n
「I've always relied on other people to take care of me. It makes me a little happy.」

123:t_1:63.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then maybe I can relax and let myself lean on you, $n.」

123:t_1:65.en:
$n
「It's not that I don't want you to... It's just... I need to prepare myself...」

123:t_1:66.en:
$$エマ$$
「Judging from that reaction, you're still not ready to handle a grown woman.」

123:t_1:68.en:
$$ファ$$
「Oh, $$カミーユ$$. You're still a child yourself.」

123:t_1:69.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Before you talk about $n, you should try harder yourself, $$カミーユ$$.」

123:t_1:70.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Hard enough to handle me as well as $$ファ$$.」

123:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're right. I guess I still have a long way to go too.」

123:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hee hee... You do your best too, $$カミーユ$$.」

123:t_1:76.en:
$n
「How do you feel, Miss $$スズネ$$? Has that eased your nerves a little?」

123:t_1:77.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you. Thanks to you and everyone else, $n, I can fight too.」

123:t_1:80.en:
$n
「I've stopped letting anxiety frighten me. I'll overcome it.」
